text.en:
Fifty thousand pesos are hereby appropriated, out of any funds in the Insular Treasury not
otherwise appropriated, for the support of the School of Household Industries, created by Act Numbered
Twenty-one hundred and ten of the Philippine Legislature.
Enacted, February 3, 1913.
